summary: Adult Drosophila brain atlas across ageing (Davie et al. 2018, Cell), rebuilt from GEO GSE107451 to replace the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006090 (E-CURD-91) with fresh VFBseq ids. Scope is the paper's 57K stringently filtered 10x set: 26 Samples/Assays (12 DGRP-551, 14 w1118; adult brains 0-50 days). Seven Clusterings with one Cluster per author cluster (125): 87 at resolution 2.0 (Table S2), 5 S2-annotated at resolution 8.0, 18 sub-clusters of resolution-2.0 clusters 20/27/42/64, and 15 neuropeptide re-clustering groups; 82 mapped to FBbt and loaded, 43 held. Summary expression for the loaded Clusters as CPM from the 10x count matrix (194,453 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2; dataset total/filtered gene counts 14,456 / 6,704).

decisions.decision: Restructure: one row per author cluster, never merged by cell type; cluster typing from the authors, not from re-analysis.

Seven Clusterings / 125 Clusters (build_clusters.py): 87 resolution-2.0 clusters (Table S2), 5 S2-annotated resolution-8.0 clusters, sub-clusterings of resolution-2.0 clusters 20/27/42/64 (5+9+2+2), and 15 neuropeptide re-clustering groups. The 18 sub-clusters are linked to their parent resolution-2.0 cluster via parent_cluster (BFO:0000050 part of; new schema slot); resolution-8.0 and neuropeptide clusters have no parent. Cluster type is the authors' GEO annotation (sub-clustered parents take the Table S2 parent call); the Table S2 call is recorded per cluster.

Face-value mapping rule: the authors' named type maps to that FBbt term; grouped calls map to the common parent; no downgrading from our own marker or contamination reading. 21 types re-mapped under this rule. Type-level mappings (type_mapping/) were made by map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents from per-type reports and copied per cluster into mapping/.
General rule: a cluster with no FBbt term is held. Here 43 held: the 42 clusters the authors left numbered (unannotated) and Hsp, which has no FBbt term.
new_term_needed is recorded for Poxn and Proc/Gpb5, but no FBbt term requests will be made (terms from expression alone are the exception).
The OLS MCP was returning 503 during the re-map, so agents looked terms up via the OLS4 REST API, a local fbbt-full.obo, or VFB.
Replace the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006090 (E-CURD-91) with fresh VFBseq ids and no FBlc link; its FBbt terms are used only as a mapping cross-check.
Scope: the paper's 57K stringently filtered 10x set only, 26 GSMs (12 DGRP-551, 14 w1118; adults 0-50 days), selected by the sample_build.title_pattern regex.

Samples: stage FBdv 'day N of adulthood'; tissue FBbt:00003624 adult brain; sex mixed (20 female + 20 male brains per run; sex slot unset); stocks FBst0055026 / FBst0003605 from FlyBase Chado. No stage on Clusters (stage is on Samples; a Cluster gets one only when determined from its own expression).

Curator hand edits (manual_edit): Photoreceptors -> rhabdomeric photoreceptor cell; Mip/OCT -> adult myoinhibitory peptide neuron; Mip/ITP -> Mip + ITP neuron; AstA/NPF -> AstA + adult NPF neuron; Proc/Ms -> Ms neuron.
The 57K MEX tarball was unpacked and its files re-gzipped into .cache; the recorded checksums are of the re-gzipped files.
Expression per Clustering from a barcode -> cluster membership file (a cell is counted once per Clustering), as CPM; rows kept with extent > 0.2.

Gene ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (FB2026_03, FlyBase Chado; gene_id_map.tsv via update_gene_ids.py): 132 secondary ids -> current gene (5 merges, counts summed per cell); 5 split ids and 1 withdrawn id (snRNA:U3) dropped; symbols refreshed.

Publication FBrf0239740 resolved from VFB production (pdb) by PMID; it is not in the curation KB. Earlier KB 401s were caused by the curator's VFB_KB_* env vars for the writable KB being picked up, so pub.py now uses VFBSEQ_* overrides.

Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, Cluster entity or expression rows; previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected. Here 43 held clusters left out and 82 Clusters loaded.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.
Assays named "<Sample>, 10x library" (one library per Sample), previously the accession or library id; ids unchanged.

Narrow by dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the term exact: the brain-only dissection makes the existing 'adult brain ...' glia terms (cell body, perineurial, subperineurial glia) exact, so they are kept. Clusters that could only be typed as 'cell' or 'neuron' stay held.

checks.check: Authors' GEO annotation of each cluster compared with its Table S2 call.
checks.result: 14 clusters with a differing S2 call flagged (author_conflict -> verification_needed).

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every distinct FBbt term in the mappings looked up in live OLS FBbt.
checks.result: All 62 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: Cross-check against the old load FBlc0006090: its FBbt terms crosswalked by author type and compared with the terms used here.
checks.result: Agree for 60 typed clusters, differ for 6 (in all 6 the more specific adult / adult-brain term was chosen here).

checks.check: Stock FBst ids for DGRP-551 / w[1118] from FlyBase Chado cross-checked against the paper's Key Resources Table.
Current/secondary FBgn mapping from FlyBase Chado cross-checked against fbgn_annotation_ID_fb_2026_03.tsv.
Local paper index re-ingested at Atlas-reporter 2acd38e (atlas-chat renamed; the original 4c90b6c is no longer on main).
checks.result: Index reproduced exactly; local-index code is byte-identical, so this provenance is reproducible from 2acd38e.
